hooks.name: Verify Model Tier Routing
hooks.description: Ensures model calls use cost-optimal tier routing to stay within $50 hackathon budget

action.prompt: If backend Python code was just modified and contains a call_model() invocation, verify the task_type routes to the cheapest appropriate tier. Nano ($0.06/1M) should handle extraction and classification. Super ($0.30/1M) for deep analysis only. Ultra ($1.00/1M) for final synthesis only. Flag any call that routes to a more expensive tier than necessary for the task.
